projects.title: DevFlow - Developer Community Platform
projects.subtitle: A full-stack Q&A platform for developers powered by AI recommendations.
projects.description: DevFlow is a modern community Q&A platform designed to help developers ask questions, share insights, and get smart recommendations. Built with Next.js App Router, Server Actions, and MongoDB, it features real-time search, badge rewards, and AI-powered answer generation.
highlights: Architected with Next.js 14 App Router and Server Actions for fast server-side rendering.
Integrated OpenAI API to provide auto-generated answer summaries for complex queries.
Implemented global search with debouncing and multi-filter taxonomy system.
